note: A synthetic sample written for the tests: 20 memories in the style of a show's notes, and 30 questions: some paraphrased, one with typos (which only the trigram search can find), three that share no word with their answer (which neither can find), and five the memory should decline. It checks the machinery. It is not a benchmark of anything; write a golden set from your own shows.

memories.text: The haze cue in scene two fired 400 ms late because the lighting desk was busy answering a fixture scan.
The venue Wi-Fi drops every night at ten, so run the show on the wired network only.
Lighting wants a two second pre-wait on every look so the desk can load it.
Lasers are armed last, by the laser safety officer, and never before the area is clear.
Alex rejected the agent's proposal to move the finale earlier: it was too close to the laser cue.
The house desk lives at 10.0.0.45 since the March rewire; the old address 10.0.0.20 is dead.
The audio snapshot recall failed twice at soundcheck with no route to host; the switch port had been unplugged.
Sam prefers the stage left monitor mix quiet during the finale.
Audience polls close ninety seconds before the finale so the result can be read out.
The standby took over after the primary lost power, and the show carried on in about three seconds.
The loading dock door sticks in the cold and needs two people to open it.
Every cue sheet change goes through a proposal and is approved by the stage manager.
Timecode from the media server stopped for eleven seconds in act two and the locked scene did not fire its cues.
The director decided to cut the fireworks cue from the second act because the venue banned pyrotechnics.
Re-patch the haze machine before soundcheck.
Power in the east wing trips if the fog machine and the lasers are on one circuit.
The visual department keeps its scenes under thirty seconds so the renderer can preload them.
Priya wants cue numbers read aloud in the call sheet, not just shown.
The OBS scene switch lagged four seconds because the stream encoder was overloaded.
Approved moving the blackout earlier by half a second to match the music hit.
